headline: Reserve Bank of India to Conduct ₹50,000 Crore 3-Day Variable Rate Repo
summary: The Reserve Bank of India announced a ₹50,000 crore 3-day Variable Rate Repo auction under its liquidity adjustment facility on November 20, 2026.
why: The RBI uses Variable Rate Repo operations to address transient banking system cash deficits and anchor overnight money market rates near the policy repo rate.

impacts.name: India Overnight Interbank Rate
impacts.why: Injecting ₹50,000 crore via repo auction alleviates short-term liquidity deficits and stabilizes interbank lending costs.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
